name: context-alert
description: Band above the prompt for long context (nudging /_handoff) and for a cold prompt cache (a button that hands off without reloading); holds the first message sent into a cold thread, for the phone; in Claude project threads, a cold message moves to a fresh thread from a Sonnet handoff by default (⏩ continues here, ❌ drops), and the old thread gets a 'handed off to' link; smart queue: '/q text' (or the coordinator's 'thread-queue add:' note) waits until the agent stops, then goes out unless Haiku sees the last reply asks Matt something first
